name: Ru Kiln
ability: Once per round, when you complete any Order using a Celadon, Plain Masterpiece, gain 4 VP.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你用1件青釉、素面珍品完成任意订单时，获得4分。

name: Guan Kiln
ability: Once per round, when you complete an Order showing at least 1 Crown, gain 2 Coins. You may also have one ceramic used for that Order ignore its direct and relational Decoration requirements. Shape, Glaze and Quality still apply.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你完成至少有1个皇冠的订单时，获得2铜钱。你也可让该订单使用的1件陶瓷忽略直接及关系性装饰要求；器形、釉色和品第要求仍须满足。

name: Ge Kiln
ability: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated but before Quality is assigned, choose one of your ceramics whose Actual Heat differs from Preferred Heat by exactly 1. Set its Actual Heat to Preferred Heat and change its Decoration to Crackle at no cost.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在计算实际火候后、判定品第之前，选择你1件实际火候与适温恰好相差1的陶瓷。将其实际火候设为适温，并免费把装饰改为开片。

name: Ding Kiln
ability: Once per round, when resolving a Potter's Wheel action, after you form a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer, you may form one additional vessel of the same Shape at normal Clay cost. This additional vessel does not count against the action's normal limit.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在结算拉坯轮行动时，于你成型1件碗、盘或洗之后，可支付正常黏土费用再成型1件相同器形。此额外器物不计入该行动的正常上限。

name: Jun Kiln
ability: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated but before Quality is assigned, you may pay 1 Wood to adjust the Actual Heat of one of your ceramics by +1 or -1.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在计算实际火候后、判定品第之前，可支付1柴薪，将你1件陶瓷的实际火候调整+1或-1。
